title: Does the headline 4096-byte result survive a symmetric recipe search? The 0012 protocol, unchanged, applied to corpus A (0003's corpus, 0003's sealed evaluation set, 0003's 800000-row pool): eight enumerated recipes for the HGB model and for each baseline head with a hyperparameter, the 0003 recipe first in every list, one selection rule on a chunk-rule holdout, one confirmatory fit per head, one scoring per role, the model last, every baseline floored at its 0003 value. It can overturn the record's headline margin, and that is the point.

scope.one_line: One corpus (corpus A, data/pivot/full_c4096.npz, the 0003 corpus, not rebuilt), one seed (20260825), one rung (800000, 0003's top rung), 0003's sealed evaluation set (260000 rows from 10000 held-out chunks) scored once per role. It asks whether the CURVE_ESTABLISHED margins (+0.1003 over the frozen set, +0.0583 over the expanded set) stand when the baselines are given the same search the model gets - the question 0012 answered at 2048 with 'no, the baseline moves more'.
scope.why_this_is_the_biggest_open_risk: At 2048 (0012, read under 0013) the standardised logistic gained 0.062 over the raw 0003-recipe logistic while the searched model gained 0.0379, and the margin fell from +0.0475 to +0.0234. The headline 4096 margins were measured against the same raw logistic (0.1392) and the same unpruned depth-16 tree (0.1812). If the same lift appears at 4096 the expanded margin (0.2395 - 0.1812 = 0.0583) could fall under 0.05 unless the searched model gains at least as much. The record cannot carry a headline that has not been measured against a fair baseline; this preregistration measures it, and commits in advance to publishing either answer at the same size.
scope.corpus: data/pivot/full_c4096.npz exactly as 0003 left it: 1300000 rows from 50000 source chunks 0..49999 measured from the g array, carve 4096, chunk size 32768 (deflate_curve.json), 1108 features. The cache was built before build metadata was written into caches, so the runner identifies it by the sha256 of its y (int16) and g (int32) arrays, sealed here as cache_identity and banked in artifacts/pivot/corpus_manifest.json (2b70426881e569f303c400b8dc2b3cb69f30dbe2e36a93dff56df54df9acf093 and eda31b7cfa24640dff694c00e62849537490c9572966a5247d1f5127800e4df9); a cache whose arrays hash otherwise is refused. No corpus is built.
scope.seed: 20260825 throughout, as in 0003 and 0012; seed + 1 solely for M8's chunk-grouped validation split.
scope.rungs: One: 800000 rows, 0003's top rung, the same rows in the same order: tools/pivot/run_carve.py grouped_split(seed 20260825, eval_frac 0.2, cap 800000) is the same procedure run_study.py used for 0003 (shuffle the chunk ids, hold out the first 20%, shuffle the training rows, take the first 800000). No ladder and no slope; 0003's slope and cluster interval stand.
scope.split_identity_checked_before_any_fit: The reconstructed evaluation set has 260000 rows from 10000 chunks, of which 227006 are not gutenberg - exactly 260000 minus the 32994 gutenberg evaluation rows banked in artifacts/pivot/baseline_family_rescore.json - and the reconstructed pool is 800000 rows from 40000 chunks, 0003's n_train. The confirmatory reproduction clauses (the incumbent within 0.005 of 0.2395, the 0003 logistic within 0.005 of 0.1392) are the run-time check; a split that is not 0003's cannot reproduce both.

scope.model_and_features: Unchanged from 0012: the 1108 columns of tools/pivot/features.py as stored in the cache; only the fitting recipe is searched. The rosters are 0012's, candidate for candidate, so the two sizes are searched identically; the 0003 recipes are M1, L1, D1, T1 and T2, the same objects as 0011's.
scope.why_the_search_is_symmetric: As 0012, unchanged: same roster size (8) for every head with a hyperparameter, the same two stages on the same rows, the same holdout, the same metric, ties to the lower roster index, one confirmatory fit per head on the same 800000 rows, one scoring per role. The same asymmetries are accepted and stated (compute favours the model; the floored maximum over four or six baseline heads runs against it; HGB fits on 90%% of its block by its inherited protocol; the baseline side selects four winners from four lists).
scope.selection_never_sees_the_evaluation_set: As 0012: --stage select gathers only the holdout and the stage blocks and banks the measured count of evaluation rows gathered (must be 0); --stage confirm binds the selection file's hash into every confirmatory ledger entry and fits the model last. Disclosed: this is the second preregistration scored on 0003's sealed set (0003 scored it 4 rungs + 7 baselines + null = 12 times; 0006 scored it for top-k; 0014 adds 8 to 10), and the rosters were written with 0003's, 0011's and 0012's numbers known. Smoke runs of the runner (stamped smoke true, read VOID by the reader, never an input to any decision) gather and score the sealed set in their confirm stage as well; each smoke confirm is one more scoring of the set, and their count is banked in artifacts/pivot/engineering_log_0014.json.
scope.inherited_conventions: As 0012, unchanged. In addition the incumbent's early-stopping validation split at 800000 rows is the last 80000 rows of the pool, the same fragment-level rule 0003 used.
scope.cost: EXTRAPOLATION, basis 0012's banked seconds scaled by rows. 0012 banked 17895.9 s of selection fit time (stage 1 on 100000 rows, stage 2 on 399831 rows) and 6847.7 s of confirmatory fit time on 500000 rows. Stage 1 is the same 100000 rows here (about 7200 s in 0012 across all heads). Stage 2 runs on 639227 rows, 1.6 times 0012's block: about 1.6 x 10700 s = 17000 s. Confirmatory fits run on 800000 rows, 1.6 times 0012's pool: about 1.6 x 6850 s = 11000 s; 0003 banked 1324.6 s for the incumbent at 800000 rows on 4 cores, against 0012's 1120.5 s at 500000 on 3 threads, consistent with that scaling. Typical total about 35000 s (10 h) of fit time; worst case (every HGB and logistic candidate to its cap) about 1.6 times 0012's worst case, about 100000 s; the stage-A cap is 120000 s. Memory (arithmetic, labelled; every figure is ANONYMOUS resident memory, RssAnon, which is what the container's ceiling counts - the 5.77 GB file-backed mapping of the cache is excluded and banked separately as rss_total_gb): stage select holds the 639227 x 1108 float64 stage-2 block, 5.67 GB, plus the 160773-row float32 holdout, 0.71 GB; a tree adds a 2.83 GB float32 transient, HGB a 0.7 GB binned copy: peak about 9.3 GB. Stage confirm holds the 800000-row pool, 7.09 GB, plus the 260000-row evaluation block, 1.15 GB; a tree adds a 3.55 GB transient, HGB 0.89 GB binned; the standardised logistic scales the pool in place with a chunkwise two-pass mean and standard deviation (the runner no longer calls numpy's std, whose full-size temporary 0012 banked as +4.3 GB of ru_maxrss at 500000 rows and would have been +7.09 GB here, on top of 8.24 GB, against a 16.46 GB container with no swap): peak about 12.2 to 12.6 GB at the unlimited-depth tree's confirmatory fit (T6/T7 class: 7.09 + 1.15 + a 3.55 GB float32 copy + about 0.4 of process + the tree's own node arrays). The container reported 16.46 GB total and 14.9 GB available on 2026-09-04 with no swap; this box has killed processes at about 13.9 GB (engineering_log.json, five kills), so the launch precondition requires 12.0 GB available and infeasible_memory is stamped from a heartbeat at or above 13.0 GB anonymous - a threshold that is reachable, unlike 14.5 GB against a 13.9 GB ceiling. Disk: checkpoints are kilobytes; confirmatory records carry 260000-int8 vectors, about 780 KB each; the scores file about 8 MB. Three limits of this arithmetic, stated: (a) HGB's bin mapper draws a 200000-row float64 subsample, a 1.77 GB transient, so the HGB confirmatory peak is about 10.9 GB, not 9.1; that deep-tree peak leaves about 1.3 to 1.7 GB of headroom under the 13.9 GB ceiling and sits below the 13.0 GB threshold; the launch precondition (min_mem_available_gb 12.0) is a MemAvailable check, which counts reclaimable page cache including the mapped cache's resident pages, so it gates only a gross shortfall at launch - the anonymous-memory guard during the run is the 13.0 GB heartbeat rule; (b) the heartbeat samples every 30 s, so a transient shorter than that is invisible to it and to the infeasible_memory rule, which is why the standardiser's transient is measured once per process under tracemalloc and banked in every record's environment (standardiser_probe.peak_extra_fraction_of_block; a value near 0 means no pool-sized temporary); (c) the selection cap is checked before each fit against the banked seconds of completed fits, so it can be exceeded by at most one fit, and the 100000 s worst case over-scales stage 1, which runs on the same 100000 rows as 0012, while iteration counts at 4096 are not anchored by 0012 at all: HGB candidates may stop later on the 4096 features than on the 2048 ones, and no number here bounds that.
scope.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: Genuinely uncertain, and stated so. From 0012's banked lifts: the standardised logistic gained 0.062 at 2048 and the searched model 0.0379. If both lifts carried to 4096 the searched logistic would reach about 0.20 and the searched model about 0.28, leaving the frozen and expanded readings near +0.08 - RECIPE_CLEARS. If the model's lift is smaller at 4096 (the incumbent was tuned on 4096 pilot data, so its recipe is less wrong there than at 2048) and the logistic's is not, the expanded margin could fall toward 0.04 - RECIPE_FAILS. The honest prior is RECIPE_CLEARS with a real chance of RECIPE_FAILS; either outcome is published at the same size, and a RECIPE_FAILS would be filed as a correction to the record's headline framing at full size.
scope.what_a_fail_would_mean_for_the_record: That the CURVE_ESTABLISHED margins of 0003 were measured against baselines a symmetric search could beat, and that the headline's +0.0583 stricter margin does not survive a fair baseline. 0003's verdict would stand on its own frozen reader (it is not revised), but VERDICT.md, README.md and every outbound document would carry the searched margin beside it and a correction would be filed. That is the whole reason to run this now rather than after a raise.
scope.what_this_does_not_cover: Everything 0012 did not cover, at 4096. It does not redo the ladder or the slope; it measures one rung. It does not search the 1024 or 2048 sizes again. Nothing here establishes a buyer, a customer, a user or a partner.

candidates.why: 0003's incumbent verbatim (run_study.py make_model 'hgb', run_carve.py's explicit last-10% validation split); every other parameter at the sklearn 1.9.0 default
horizon only: was the incumbent stopped early by patience 10 on a 26-class validation loss that moves by thousandths? (at 2048 it fired after 22 iterations at 100000 rows and 38 at 500000)
lower rate, longer horizon: the standard boosting trade; the cap of 300 bounds the worst-case cost
capacity plus regularisation plus a lower rate together: 800000 rows x 26 classes supports bigger trees than 63 leaves, and the deep-tree baseline gained 0.1459 -> 0.1812 from depth 8 to 16 at 4096
the wide-tree end with the leaf-size regulariser that matters for 26-way splits on noisy histogram columns; run_study.py records that unregularised capacity collapsed the 100k rung once

per-split column subsampling: feature_ablation.json banks that the 555 alignment columns carry little, i.e. about half the 1108-column vector is near-redundant, and subsampling is the cheap decorrelator (new in sklearn 1.4, unavailable to the 0003 pilot)
the low-variance end: small trees with heavy L2; at chance 0.038 and top-1 0.17 the task is signal-starved and a lower-variance learner can beat a higher-capacity one at the same data

scope_parameters_sealed.passes_if: preregistration == '0014-recipe-search-4096'; smoke is False; stage == 'confirm'; the corpus block equals the sealed constants (carve 4096 by sealed cache identity (the cache carries no build metadata), chunk size 32768, offset 0, measured chunk-id range 0..49999, 50000 chunks, 1300000 rows, 1108 features, cache_y_sha256 and cache_g_sha256 equal to the manifest's); n_classes == 26 and chance_accuracy == 0.038462; the banked roster and roster_sha256 equal the reader's ROSTER_SHA256; the banked protocol block equals the reader's PROTOCOL constant field by field. Any mismatch is VOID.

sealed_sets.passes_if: The banked partition equals the sealed constants field by field: the evaluation set (260000 rows, 10000 chunks, 227006 non-gutenberg rows, index and label hashes), the pool (800000 rows, 40000 chunks, index, label and sorted-set hashes), the holdout (rule 'chunk_id % 5 == 0', 160773 rows, 8040 chunks, index and chunk-set hashes), the fit pool (639227 rows, 31960 chunks, hashes), the stage blocks (100000 and 639227 rows, keep 2 and 1, chunk counts, index and sorted-set hashes); split_is_grouped_by_source is True; the null block's sorted-set hash is the sealed one. Otherwise VOID.

no_leakage.passes_if: Measured chunk overlaps holdout/eval, holdout/fit-pool and fit-pool/eval are 0 and eval rows in the holdout and the fit pool are 0; the selection file exists on disk, its sha256 equals the artifact's selection_sha256, the embedded copy equals it, it is this preregistration's non-smoke stage-select output with the sealed roster hash, its partition block equals the sealed constants, it gathered 0 evaluation rows (the counter and every gather entry), it finished before confirmation started, and every 'selection_bound' ledger entry carries its hash. Otherwise VOID.

search_completed_as_enumerated.passes_if: For every searched head: exactly two stages; stage-1 records cover the roster in order, each with seed 20260825, the sealed stage row count, index hash and sorted-set hash, a params hash equal to sha256(canonical candidate), status 'fit' or 'infeasible_memory', finite scores when 'fit', and the banked environment (threads 3, nice 10, sklearn 1.9.0, numpy 2.4.6); the banked ranking, advanced set and winner equal the reader's re-derivation (highest holdout top-1 among 'fit', ties at 4 decimals to the lower roster index; keep 2 then 1). Any baseline-side record that is not 'fit' is VOID. On the model side at most 2 'infeasible_memory' records, each with banked evidence, and never M1. Knob-free heads select their single candidate with no stages. Otherwise VOID.

confirmatory_complete_one_scoring_per_ro.passes_if: complete is True; every head's confirmatory record has status 'fit', finite top-1, non-gutenberg top-1 and eight per-family accuracies, the selected id (no substitution), a params hash on the roster, the sealed pool hashes, seed 20260825, 800000 rows, probe_ok on every refill, the banked environment, exactly one 'completed' ledger event, and a 260000-length per-example vector in the scores file; the incumbent refit and the 0003 logistic refit likewise (or, when M1 / L1 won, they are the head's own record); the model's confirmatory completion is the LAST confirmatory completion in the ledger. Otherwise VOID.

reproduces_0003_fixed_recipes.passes_if: abs(incumbent_refit_top1 - 0.2395) <= 0.005 and abs(logistic_l1_refit_top1 - 0.1392) <= 0.005: the fixed 0003 recipes refit on the 800000-row pool exactly as 0003 fitted them and scored once on the sealed set must reproduce 0003's banked values (0003's own transfer model reproduced corpus A's matched-rung accuracy under the same convention). Failure is VOID: the run is not measuring 0003's pipeline, so any changed margin would be drift in disguise. The drifts are banked as readings.

null_control.passes_if: shuffled_label_accuracy <= chance_accuracy + 0.02, where the control is the SELECTED model recipe fitted on the 20000-row null block (sorted-set hash sealed) with 0003's shuffled labels and scored once on the sealed set. Above tolerance is VOID: the pipeline leaks under the chosen recipe.

bar_arithmetic.passes_if: The reader recomputes bar_h = max(head h's confirmatory top-1, floor_h) for the six baseline heads with the floors in scope.roster.protocol.floors, best_frozen_for_bar as the maximum over the frozen heads, best_expanded_for_bar over all six, and best_expanded_non_gutenberg_for_bar likewise on the non-gutenberg scores with floors_non_gutenberg; the banked values must equal the recomputed ones and the model receives no floor. Any inequality is VOID. The floors mean the searched baselines can raise the bar and never lower it below where 0003 left it.

margin_frozen.passes_if: round(final_top1 - best_frozen_for_bar, 6) >= 0.05 - 1e-9, where final_top1 is the selected model recipe's single evaluation top-1 at 800000 rows (banked to 4 decimals). Under 0003's fixed recipes this margin was +0.1003 (0.2395 against logistic 0.1392); the run exists to learn whether a searched logistic narrows it below the bar.

margin_expanded.passes_if: round(final_top1 - best_expanded_for_bar, 6) >= 0.05 - 1e-9, the maximum now including best_single_feat and the searched deep_tree head (floor 0.1812).

margin_expanded_gutenberg_excluded.passes_if: round(final_top1_non_gutenberg - best_expanded_non_gutenberg_for_bar, 6) >= 0.05 - 1e-9, both on the 227006 evaluation rows whose family is not gutenberg (floor 0.1891). A missing field is VOID, never a pass. A frozen-non-gutenberg clause is not added: its bar can never exceed the expanded-non-gutenberg bar, so it would be redundant.

margin_arithmetic.passes_if: Every margin clause compares round(a - b, 6) against 0.05 - 1e-9 on accuracies banked to 4 decimals, as in 0003: a margin printed as 0.0500 passes and 0.0499 fails; the binary-float representation of the difference decides nothing.

arms: SYMMETRIC SEARCH: four searched heads (model, logistic, depth3_tree, deep_tree) with eight enumerated recipes each and the 0003 recipe first; stage 1 fits all eight on the sealed 100000-row block and scores them on the chunk-rule holdout; the top 2 refit on the whole 639227-row fit pool; the stage-2 winner (ties to the lower index) is the head's recipe. The three knob-free heads skip selection.

CONFIRMATORY, ONE SCORING PER ROLE, MODEL LAST: the incumbent (M1) and the 0003 logistic (L1) refit on the pool as reproduction controls, then majority, stratified, best_single_feat, the depth3_tree winner, the deep_tree winner, the logistic winner, the null control with the selected model recipe, and the model winner last - each fitted once on 0003's 800000 rows and scored once on 0003's evaluation set.

THE BASELINES CAN ONLY RAISE THE BAR: each baseline head's contribution is max(its searched confirmatory score, its 0003 banked score); the model has no floor. This is the rival explanation 'the searched baseline happened to score below its 0003 recipe on the evaluation set' closed as arithmetic, not as a paragraph.
SELECTION CANNOT SEE THE EVALUATION SET: a separate invocation that banks a measured count of evaluation rows gathered (0) and whose output file is hashed into every confirmatory ledger entry.

VALIDITY FIRST: a wrong corpus, set, roster or protocol, a leaking selection, a baseline that dropped out, a role scored twice, a reproduction outside 0.005, a leaking null control or a bar that does not recompute is VOID and brackets nothing.
PER-FAMILY accuracies and cluster-bootstrap intervals are banked for every confirmatory record; they carry no clause.
stop_rules: Any margin clause failing is RECIPE_FAILS, published at the same size as a pass would have been; a run in which only margin_frozen passes is RECIPE_FAILS, with frozen_reading_clears banked as an informational field stamped 'not a verdict, not quotable as a pass'.

A validity or control failure is VOID: the clause is named, nothing is bracketed, nothing is counted in either direction; a VOID run may be resumed from its checkpoints under the identical invocation and is never re-parameterised; a changed roster, rung, rule or tolerance is a new preregistration with this one's VOID or NOT RUN on the record.

NOT RUN is reachable only before the first evaluation-touching checkpoint and only by mechanical rules (a failed launch precondition; three consecutive launches of a stage that produced no new checkpoint; stage-A fit seconds above caps.selection_fit_seconds); it is filed as artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_4096_not_run.json, the reader prints it and exits 2, and nothing is re-scoped to fewer candidates, a smaller rung or a lower bar.

Once stage confirm has written any checkpoint the artifact exists at the sealed path with complete false and reads VOID naming the missing roles until every role is banked; abandonment after that point is a published VOID, never a silent NOT RUN; every confirmatory fit runs to completion with no time cap; the model winner is fitted last.
No candidate is added, removed or re-parameterised after freeze: the roster hashes to a literal in the frozen reader and sits under the sealed scope; a record whose params hash is off-roster is VOID.

The sealed evaluation set is scored exactly once per confirmatory role; no runner-up substitution on either side; no re-selection in stage confirm; no time-based or seconds-based eligibility anywhere; ties break by roster index only; interruptions are counted, never turned into a status; infeasible_memory is stamped only on a caught MemoryError or a kill whose last heartbeat RSS was at or above 13.0 GB, with the evidence banked. RSS here means anonymous resident memory (RssAnon), which excludes the file-backed pages of the memory-mapped cache; the runner banks the total beside it.
The 0.05 bar is not lowered, 0003's three readings are all required, and absence, NaN or inf read as VOID.

This cannot revise 0003, 0006, 0007 or 0011; 0011's CARVE_FAILS and (2048, 4096] stand for the frozen recipe whatever this returns; revises_0003_0006_0007_0011 and establishes_a_buyer are emitted False unconditionally; no customer, user, partner or buyer is claimed.

Cost is banked beside the result (fit seconds, ru_maxrss and heartbeat RSS per record, launches, interruptions, refills, the environment) and gates nothing in the reader; every cost figure in this preregistration is labelled EXTRAPOLATION with its basis.
The corpus, the evaluation set, the pool and the partition are one draw and are not redrawn; smoke runs write only to the scratchpad, are stamped smoke true, and read VOID.

If the run cannot complete under the container's memory (an infeasible_memory on the baseline side, or a third on the model side, or the incumbent), the result is VOID, filed as such, and nothing in the recipe is changed to make it fit.

A RECIPE_FAILS is filed as a correction against the record's headline framing at full size, in CORRECTIONS.md, VERDICT.md, README.md and every outbound document, before anything else is done with the number.

thesis.what_would_make_it_fail_honestly: The baseline side having more headroom than the model at 4096 as it did at 2048: a standardised converged logistic gaining several points over 0.1392, an unlimited-depth regularised tree gaining over 0.1812, and the model, already tuned on 4096 pilot data, gaining less than 0.0379.
thesis.what_a_pass_would_mean: That the headline result survives the fairest baseline this repository knows how to build: the 4096-byte carve clears the 0.05 bar under a search that gave the baselines the same treatment as the model. The record's working-window statement would then rest on a searched margin, not a frozen one.
thesis.what_neither_outcome_means: Neither names a buyer. Neither revises 0003's verdict on its own reader. Neither says anything below 4096.

invocation: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=3 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=3 MKL_NUM_THREADS=3; nice -n 10 python3 tools/pivot/run_recipe_search.py --stage select --prereg-file prereg/0014-recipe-search-4096.json --cache data/pivot/full_c4096.npz --workdir artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_4096_ckpt --selection-out artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_4096_selection.json --out artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_4096.json --scores-out artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_4096_scores.json; then the same with --stage confirm; then python3 tools/readers/recipe4096_verdict.py. Relaunching the identical command after a container restart is the whole recovery procedure; checkpoints are committed and pushed as they land.

smoke.invocation: The invocation above with --smoke added and --workdir, --selection-out, --out and --scores-out pointed under the session scratchpad; the runner refuses --smoke with any output path under artifacts/, and refuses a real run with any output path outside it. The smoke block replaces top_rung, stages, null_rows and launch; everything else is the sealed protocol.
